summary: The candidate is test/report-only hardening around a one-level PretrainedConfig update already present on the recorded base. Its issue-shaped full rope_parameters replacement passes, but an independent deeper partial override discards an unmentioned nested sibling, so it does not prove or implement recursive merging.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded base suite: 4 passed plus 2 processor subtests; confirms the prepared base already has the one-level nested PretrainedConfig fix.
Candidate suite: 5 passed plus 2 processor subtests, including the reported complete rope_parameters shape and scalar/plain-dict replacement boundaries.
A partial override of text_config.rope_parameters.rope_theta yielded only {rope_theta: 20000.0}; the existing rope_type sibling was discarded, contradicting recursive merge semantics.
Candidate report artifact reports/j-8a58c3effab9/raw/pytest_hf_transformers_loading.txt contains trailing whitespace on line 5.

gpu_execution.evidence: Configuration loading tests are CPU-only. Environment inspection found one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; the reported TP=2 RTX 5090 CUDA workload is unavailable.

remaining_counterexamples: Given existing rope_parameters {rope_type: default, rope_theta: 10000.0}, overriding only text_config.rope_parameters.rope_theta with 20000.0 discards rope_type instead of recursively preserving it.
remaining_limitations: The reported two-GPU RTX 5090 CUDA/NVFP4 TP=2 serving path cannot be reproduced on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU.
No claims are made about full server startup, NVFP4 execution, distributed behavior, or model semantic accuracy.
